records.title: PROMOTION OF COAL GASIFICATION AND CLEAN COAL TECHNOLOGIES
details:
National Coal Gasification Mission has set a target of achieving 100 Million Tonnes 
(MT) of coal gasification capacity by 2030. As on date, approximately 22.6 Million Tonnes 
Per Annum (MTPA) of coal gasification capacity is operational or under implementation, 
comprising: 
(ii) Talcher Fertilisers Limited (TFL): ~2.6 MTPA (under implementation) 
(iii) 8 Projects under the ₹8,500 crore Financial Incentive Scheme of 24.01.2024: ~12 
MTPA (under implementation)
